english_title: Example 3.3: A Trivial Example for the Above Properties
statement_en: Let $f(x)=\sin(x)$. Then $$\limsup_{x\to \infty}\sin(x)=1,\qquad \liminf_{x\to \infty}\sin(x)=-1.$$ Moreover, explicit sequences realizing these values are $$x_n:=\frac{\pi}{2}+2\pi n,\qquad y_n:=\frac{3\pi}{2}+2\pi n,$$ for which $\sin(x_n)\to 1$ and $\sin(y_n)\to -1$, illustrating the basic properties of function limsup and liminf.
